targets.rawSql: SELECT cpu_cores FROM capacity_snapshots WHERE device_name = '$host' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT ROUND(cpu_load_1m::numeric, 2) FROM capacity_snapshots WHERE device_name = '$host' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT ROUND(mem_headroom_pct::numeric, 1) FROM capacity_snapshots WHERE device_name = '$host' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT ROUND(disk_worst_pct::numeric, 1) FROM capacity_snapshots WHERE device_name = '$host' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT overall_status FROM capacity_snapshots WHERE device_name = '$host' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM service_registry WHERE node_name = '$host' AND status = 'up'
SELECT ts AS time, cpu_load_1m AS "1min", cpu_load_5m AS "5min", cpu_load_15m AS "15min" FROM capacity_snapshots WHERE device_name = '$host' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY 1
SELECT ts AS time, cpu_headroom_pct AS value FROM capacity_snapshots WHERE device_name = '$host' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY 1
SELECT ts AS time, mem_used_mb AS "Used", mem_free_mb AS "Free" FROM capacity_snapshots WHERE device_name = '$host' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY 1
SELECT ts AS time, mem_headroom_pct AS value FROM capacity_snapshots WHERE device_name = '$host' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY 1
SELECT ts AS time, disk_worst_pct AS value FROM capacity_snapshots WHERE device_name = '$host' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY 1
SELECT "timestamp" AS time, metric_name AS metric, metric_value AS value FROM snmp_metrics WHERE device_name = '$host' AND $__timeFilter("timestamp") ORDER BY 1

SELECT service_name, host(host)::text || ':' || port AS endpoint, status, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW() - last_heartbeat)::integer AS hb_age FROM service_registry WHERE node_name = '$host' ORDER BY service_name

list.name: host
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT device_name FROM capacity_snapshots ORDER BY 1
